description: Starship factory production. In the Reusable Interplanetary Spacecraft (Starship Class) system this piece plays the supply role: it builds ships Maturity: scaling.
how_it_works: Prepare the work environment and tooling to the process recipe.
Run the Manufacturing sequence exactly per the documented recipe.
Measure the outcome at each control checkpoint.
Accept, rework, or scrap the batch based on measured results.
requirements: Controlled environment (cleanliness, temperature, humidity as required)
standards: Statistical process control on key parameters
safety: Hazard review before first run
Interlocks and guards on process equipment
PPE matched to the process hazards
Emergency stop and evacuation drill current
troubleshooting: Low yield: check the drifted control parameters first
Defects cluster at one station: inspect tooling wear
Recipe not reproducing: verify environment and raw-material lot
Throughput drop: measure each step's cycle time
citations: Documented public research on Reusable Interplanetary Spacecraft (Starship Class): peer-reviewed literature, technical standards, industry announcements, and open technical documentation.

title: Deep-Space Variant
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Outer-planet and asteroid missions. In the Reusable Interplanetary Spacecraft (Starship Class) system this piece plays the beyond role: it goes further Maturity: concept.
key_points: Deep-Space Variant: Outer-planet and asteroid missions.
how_it_works: Assemble the Deep-Space Variant from its qualified components.
Wire its interfaces (power, data, control, mechanical) to the system bus.
Run subsystem-level functional and stress tests.
Integrate with the full system and re-run the acceptance suite.
safety: System-level hazard analysis before power-on
Interlocks verified end to end
Two-person rule for high-energy steps
Incident log reviewed after every test
troubleshooting: Integration failure: test each interface alone, then pairs
Noise or crosstalk: check grounding and shielding
Timing faults: verify clocks and synchronization margins
Regression after change: diff the configuration against the last good build
citations: Documented public research on Reusable Interplanetary Spacecraft (Starship Class): peer-reviewed literature, technical standards, industry announcements, and open technical documentation.
